summary_1line: King Ambarisha’s sacrificial horse is stolen by Indra, forcing the king to search for a replacement or a human victim to complete the ritual.

image_candidates.scene_text: Indra secretly seizes the consecrated sacrificial horse, carrying it away while the royal sacrifice stands interrupted.
King Ambarisha travels through forests and hermitages with attendants, searching desperately for the missing sacrificial horse.
The king encounters the sage Richika living with his family on the rugged slopes of Mount Bhrigutunga.
